mutants.review: New four-place purchasing tax/cost snapshot boundaries with percentage discounts passed. Changing eight-place intermediate multiplication to nine remained unobservable in these cases; no general precision equivalence proof assumed and survivor remains counted.

Configured rates are bounded decimals; native addition to 100 round-trips their supported significant digits. New rational boundary cases found no monetary/snapshot divergence. General floating-point equivalence is not assumed; survivor remains counted.

Configured production TaxSetting rates use decimal:2; negative hundredths are rejected by both guards. Sub-hundredth negative direct-calculator inputs are outside that configured contract and could differ; no new runtime policy or artificial pass assertion was introduced. Remains counted.

New independent rational nearest-half-cent residue cases tested both small and near-schema-limit bases at four-place rates. Additional guard precision changes remained unobservable at the money boundary in these supported cases; no general proof assumed, survivor retained.

Allocation shortfall is a bounded number of pennies, not the full document amount. New 17-line low-value/stable-tie case verifies discount conservation; native subtraction survived. Arbitrary-size document equivalence is not assumed; survivor retained.

Both cash distances are canonical two-place decimals bounded by the configured denomination. Native comparison matched preserved exact midpoint/large-total cases. No new affected behavior found; previous validation was not repeated and survivor remains counted.

The sign guard compares a canonical nonnegative decimal already normalized at the requested scale against zero. Both guards distinguish canonical zero/nonzero at supported scales. Existing signed/zero cases preserved; kept counted without a blanket equivalence exclusion.

Validated inputs are integer numeric strings after removal of zero fractional suffixes. PHP 8.4 compares fitting integers exactly and uses overflow-aware numeric-string ordering for adjacent out-of-range integers; prior padded/adjacent overflow assertions pass. No supported-input counterexample found; kept counted without claiming a general version-independent proof.
